question: Simplify : 3ab × (a + b)⁻¹ × (a⁻¹ + b⁻¹)
solution:
**Given:**

3ab × (a + b)-1 × (a-1 + b-1)

**Calculations:**

3ab × (a + b)-1 × (a-1 + b-1)

⇒ 3ab × (1)/((a+b)) × ((1)/(a)+(1)/(b))

⇒ 3ab × (1)/((a+b)) × ((a+b))/(ab)

⇒ 3

**∴ The Required simplified value of 3ab × (a + b)⁻¹× (a⁻¹ + b⁻¹) is 3.**
